title: Week 24 Releases (v2.1.166-v2.1.176) - June 8-12, 2026
description: Claude Code released versions v2.1.166 through v2.1.176 during Week 24 (June 8-12, 2026). Key features include new /cd command to move sessions to new working directories, nested sub-agents that can spawn their own agents, safe mode for isolating broken states, and improved OpenAI integration. Also added two new cybersecurity features.

community_feedback.quote: Developers noting comprehensive guides covering 25+ Claude Code features with examples published mid-June 2026

title: Cursor 3.8 - /automate skill and new triggers
description: Cursor released version 3.8 on June 22, 2026, introducing the /automate skill for creating automations directly in local agent sessions. Added new GitHub triggers (issue comment, PR review comment, PR review submitted, review thread updated, workflow run completed) and Slack emoji triggers. Cloud agents now support computer use for producing demos and artifacts. Bugbot performance improved: 3x faster, 22% cheaper, finds 10% more bugs.

community_feedback.quote: I never really understood the hype around Cursor. To me, it always felt like a thin UI layer on top of VSCode
Reports of Cursor dominating AI IDE rankings in 2025-2026 with Composer, Agent mode, and multi-model support

title: May 2026 releases (v1.120-v1.123)
description: GitHub Copilot in VS Code released versions v1.120 through v1.123 in May and early June 2026. Key updates include Agents window available in VS Code Stable as preview, expanded BYOK to air-gapped environments, new remote agents over SSH/Dev Tunnels, Agent Host Protocol (AHP), session preferences persist, new Git flow improvements, session sync, Chronicle commands, and multiple sessions side-by-side.

community_feedback.quote: 2021-2026, Goodbye, Copilot. I've been using Copilot since 2021 and was a paid subscriber since 2024
Starting April 24, 2026, GitHub will begin using your Copilot data for improving Copilot

title: MCP Marketplace Expansion - 48+ new engineering MCPs
description: On June 19, 2026, Devin announced MCP Marketplace Expansion with 48+ new engineering MCPs added to the marketplace including Miro, Mixpanel, Honeycomb, Postman, monday.com, Klaviyo, and others. Additionally, Devin Desktop was renamed from Windsurf on June 2, 2026, delivered as an over-the-air update.

community_feedback.quote: Organic community discussion on Hacker News and Reddit remains thin as of June 2026, with coverage being mostly press releases
Discussion about programmers shifting focus from Prompt Engineering to MCP in 2026

title: Codex CLI 0.142.0 - Usage reset credits and plugin improvements
description: Released on June 22, 2026, Codex CLI 0.142.0 adds /usage command to show and redeem earned usage-limit reset credits, /plugins now organizes remote plugins into sections, configurable rollout token budgets, multi-agent delegation controls, indexed web-search mode, and scheduled UTC time reminders. Bug fixes include restored Linux TUI rendering after suspend/resume, exec-server and stdio MCP session survival, and improved error handling.

community_feedback.quote: Bug in OpenAI's Codex CLI that writes excessive trace logs to SQLite, potentially consuming 640TB/year of SSD writes
Everything I Wish Existed When I Started Using Codex CLI - comprehensive guide covering configs, profiles, skills, orchestration patterns

title: Gemini CLI Shutdown - June 18, 2026
description: Google is shutting down Gemini CLI for free, Pro, and Ultra users on June 18, 2026. Users need to migrate before this date. The latest release v0.46.0-preview.0 includes routing optimizations and updated default auto-routing.

title: Changelog updates - May 2026
description: Windsurf (formerly Codeium) released multiple updates in May 2026 including v2.2.17 (May 5) and v2.0.44 (May 16). Recent changelog shows Codeium v1.42 updates with chat improvements, UI & visual enhancements, command improvements, and enterprise & technical updates. Note: Windsurf went through ownership changes with Cognition acquisition.

community_feedback.quote: Windsurf went through ownership changes (Cognition acquisition) and leadership departures to Google, creating uncertainty about product direction

title: No major releases in June 2026
description: Latest stable release is v0.86.2 (February 12, 2026). Last repository push was May 22, 2026. No major releases in June 2026. Aider continues as a git-first, open-source alternative to proprietary solutions with atomic git commits and architect mode.

title: Acquired by Cursor
description: Continue has been acquired by Cursor. Their mission states that developers should be 'amplified, not automated'. Final 2.0.0 release available for VS Code extension, CLI, and JetBrains plugin. GitHub releases page shows recent changes including removal of CLI-install banner and Generate Rule feature.
